meta.name: figma
meta.description: Import Figma content into a HyperFrames composition — rendered assets, brand tokens, components, storyboard sections → reconstructed motion (frames read as states, not slides) (REST/CLI), connector-assisted motion when available, and shaders from a connector or native export. Use when the user pastes a figma.com link or asks to bring a Figma design, frame, logo, brand, or animation into a video/composition.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Figma 链接里的设计稿变成能播的动态画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有 Figma 设计稿,想让它直接动起来变成视频画面。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Figma frames and brand assets into animated video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a Figma design and want it turned into animated video.

howto.what: 把 Figma 内容导入 HyperFrames 合成:渲染素材、品牌 token、组件,以及把 storyboard 分镜的帧当作状态来重建动画(不是逐帧播放)。产物是带来源记录的本地冻结文件。
howto.when: 当你粘贴 figma.com 链接,或要求把 Figma 的 logo、品牌等设计/动画带进视频或合成时触发。

say.text: 把这个 Figma 链接里的 logo 导进来
say.note: 走 asset 导出并冻结到本地

say.text: 拉一下我 Figma 文件里的品牌颜色变量
say.note: 走 tokens 导入为合成品牌变量

say.text: 照这个 frame 给我搭一个场景组件
say.note: 走 component 转成可编辑 HTML

howto.what_en: Claude imports Figma content into a HyperFrames composition — rendered assets, brand tokens, components, and storyboard sections rebuilt as motion (frames read as states). Outputs are local frozen files with recorded provenance.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you paste a figma.com link or ask to bring a Figma design, frame, logo, brand, or animation into a video or composition.

say_en.text: Import the logo from this Figma link
Pull the brand color variables from my Figma file
Build a scene component from this frame
